title: LBJ locks himself in the Air Force One bathroom

tellings.quote: Jack valante told me all about it Jack valante was with him okay so that's right jack Val was with him he locked himself in the bathroom on Air Force One

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that Jack Valenti, an aide who was with Lyndon Johnson in 1963, told him what happened on Air Force One, the president's plane, in Dallas, the day President Kennedy was shot and Johnson became president. According to Sheehan, Valenti said Johnson locked himself in the plane's bathroom. Sheehan tells it as an inside glimpse of that day.
